Kill Bill Vol. 1 & Vol. 2 (Original Soundtrack) [FLAC]
Various Artists | Soundtrack / Rock / Surf / Blues | 16-Bit FLAC
The music behind cinema's most iconic revenge.
The epic story of "The Bride" wouldn't be complete without its legendary soundtrack. Quentin Tarantino is an absolute master of musical curation, and the Kill Bill Vol. 1 and Vol. 2 albums are the ultimate proof of that. This masterful and eclectic mix travels from western, surf rock, and blues, to the epic compositions of Ennio Morricone, the urban touch of RZA (Wu-Tang Clan), and unforgettable melancholic ballads like Nancy Sinatra's "Bang Bang (My Baby Shot Me Down)". Two essential volumes, presented in lossless FLAC quality, that will immediately transport you to the bloody and highly stylized universe of the film.
